description: Verified motorcycle gear deals for every riding style, with price, retailer's listed price (the store's own comparison price, not verified by us), percent below that listed price, retailer link, as-of time, and optional made_in_usa (official-source only). Optional filters including made_in_usa.

brand.description: Optional case-insensitive filter; matches deals whose brand or name contains this string

category.description: Optional case-insensitive filter; matches deals whose category or name contains this string (e.g. helmet, jacket, pants, boots)

limit.description: Maximum number of deals to return (default 10, minimum 1, maximum 25)

made_in_usa.description: If true, only return deals tagged Made in USA from official brand sources (FTC all-or-virtually-all; never inferred)

max_price.description: Maximum deal price in USD; deals priced above this are omitted

name: current_deals
title: Current verified motorcycle gear deals
